title: Merrick (Hempstead Plains)
summary: Merrick is a Hempstead-area placename connected with the great plain south of Hempstead and later Merrick community names.
introduction_content: Merrick is connected with a small settlement southeast of Hempstead and with the broader Hempstead plains. Related forms include Merriack, Merioke, Meracock, Mericoke, Merricock, Marrocock, Mercock, Merrikoke, and Meroke.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as bare land, at the barren land, bare of trees, or a plain, fitting its association with the Hempstead plains.

Why Place Names Matter

“More recognition can be given to indigenous efforts to correct clear inaccuracies and reclaim place names whose stories are theirs and not outsiders.”

— Luise Hercus, Authenticity in toponymy (2003), Repository record abstract
whereintheworld_content: Map location note: The pin is placed near modern Merrick while the note recognizes that the older placename was associated with the broader Hempstead plains. It is not an exact historic boundary.
